name: Law of Uniform Connectedness
axiom: Where a line joins two things, people group them before they weigh the distance.
trigger: Wizard steps float unconnected, so the order has to be inferred from the numbers.

checklist.text: Join nodes in a flow editor with one continuous stroke, not arrows that stop short.
Connect checkout steps with a single track so the sequence is drawn, not implied.
Attach a tab to its panel with a shared border instead of relying on colour alone.
Remove the connecting line as a test; if grouping survives, the line was decoration.

antiPattern.violation: Four numbered circles float with no links, and the user must guess the sequence.
antiPattern.remediation: The circles sit on one continuous track that fills as each stage completes.

academicOrigin.title: Rethinking perceptual organization: The role of uniform connectedness
